name: Nicaragua

flag.description: Three equal horizontal bands of blue, white and blue, with the coat of arms in the centre: a triangle containing five volcanoes, a cap of liberty and a rainbow, circled by the words "REPUBLICA DE NICARAGUA - AMERICA CENTRAL".
flag.symbolism: The blue bands represent the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea and white the land and peace; the five volcanoes stand for the five members of the former Federal Republic of Central America.

hook: Nicaragua circles its rainbow-and-volcanoes triangle with gold lettering; El Salvador wraps its triangle in a laurel wreath, and Honduras just has stars.
trivia: The rainbow in the coat of arms makes Nicaragua's one of only two national flags that include purple, alongside Dominica's.
Lake Nicaragua is one of the few freshwater lakes in the world where bull sharks are found.
